title: World Trail Majors — All Races (2026 series)
claims: World Trail Majors lists Black Canyon Ultras presented by HOKA as one of its 10 races for the 2026 season, dated 14-15 February 2026.
The WTM listing describes Black Canyon as two races of 60 and 100 km run simultaneously along trails, tracks and old settler and stagecoach routes across Arizona to Phoenix.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接读取 WTM All Races 页，确认 Black Canyon 在 2026 十站名单内；其 60 km 表述与组委会 50K 口径不一致，正文并列。

claimVerification.note: 页面列出 BLACK CANYON ULTRAS PRESENTED BY HOKA，日期 2026/02/14-15，为十站之一
